archive_ledger.label: gaia_field
archive_ledger.query:
SELECT TOP 60000 source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmdec, ruwe, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, phot_variable_flag, non_single_star, phot_g_mean_flux_over_error, astrometric_excess_noise, teff_gspphot FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source 
        WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec),
                           CIRCLE('ICRS', 262.0, 63.5, 0.4))
          AND phot_g_mean_mag < 15.0
          AND parallax_over_error > 10.0

archive_ledger.label: neowise_field
archive_ledger.query: SELECT TOP 3000000 ra, dec, mjd, w1mpro, w1sigmpro, w2mpro, w2sigmpro, qual_frame, cc_flags, ph_qual, saa_sep, moon_masked, w1rchi2, w2rchi2 FROM neowiser_p1bs_psd WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 262.0000000, 63.5000000, 0.400000)) AND w1mpro < 14.5

cadence_bias_note: per-exposure errors are rescaled per star by the within-visit scatter; the primary statistic is the unbiased normalised excess variance and its uncertainty carries the exact N dependence (Vaughan et al. 2003); a per-field ensemble common mode is fitted and removed
instrumental_bound: NEOWISE is W1/W2 only (Wien peaks 852 K and 630 K), so this channel probes hot material and is structurally blind to 100-300 K
